project.description: Builds global allConcepts for all studies with a subject multi. Separate from file builders due to different git repos

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail
LOG_TS() { date +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z"; } log() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] INFO $*" >&2; } warn() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] WARN $*" >&2; } error() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] ERROR $*" >&2; }
need() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { error "Missing required command: $1"; exit 2; }; }
cleanup() { local rc=$? local cmd="${BASH_COMMAND:-}" local line="${BASH_LINENO[0]:-}"
if [[ $rc -eq 0 ]]; then log "EXIT rc=0 (success). Cleaning AWS env vars." else error "EXIT rc=${rc} at line=${line} cmd=${cmd}. Cleaning AWS env vars." fi
unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
if [[ -s logs/error_logging.txt ]]; then warn "logs/error_logging.txt present (last 50 lines):" tail -n 50 logs/error_logging.txt >&2 || true fi } on_err() { local rc=$? local line="${BASH_LINENO[0]:-}" local cmd="${BASH_COMMAND:-}" error "ERR rc=${rc} at line=${line} cmd=${cmd}" return $rc } trap on_err ERR trap cleanup EXIT
assume_role() { local role_arn="${ROLE_ARN:-arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl}" local session_name="${ROLE_SESSION_NAME:-s3-test}" local duration="${ASSUME_DURATION_SECONDS:-3600}"
log "Assuming role ${role_arn} (duration=${duration}s)" local assume_json assume_json="$(mktemp)"
aws sts assume-role \ --duration-seconds "$duration" \ --role-arn "$role_arn" \ --role-session-name "$session_name" \ > "$assume_json"
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID="$(jq -r '.Credentials.AccessKeyId' "$assume_json")" AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SecretAccessKey' "$assume_json")" AWS_SESSION_TOKEN="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SessionToken' "$assume_json")" rm -f "$assume_json"
log "Role assumed" }
reset_dir() { local d="$1" rm -rf "$d" mkdir -p "$d" }
# S3 "directory" safe sync: # - DOES NOT call head-object on "prefix/" (which 404s in S3) # - Uses s3 sync and fails if nothing was synced (unless allow_empty=true) s3_sync_prefix() { local src_prefix="$1" dst_dir="$2" allow_empty="${3:-false}" mkdir -p "$dst_dir"
log "S3 sync ${src_prefix} -> ${dst_dir} (allow_empty=${allow_empty})" local out out="$(mktemp)" # sync prints lines for transferred/updated files; capture output for emptiness check if ! aws s3 sync "$src_prefix" "$dst_dir" --no-progress --only-show-errors | tee "$out" >/dev/null; then rm -f "$out" error "S3 sync failed: ${src_prefix} -> ${dst_dir}" return 1 fi
# If sync produced no output AND destination is still empty, treat as empty prefix if [[ "$allow_empty" != "true" ]]; then if [[ ! -s "$out" ]] && [[ -z "$(find "$dst_dir" -type f -print -quit 2>/dev/null || true)" ]]; then rm -f "$out" error "S3 prefix appears empty or does not exist: ${src_prefix}" return 1 fi fi
rm -f "$out" return 0 }
s3_cp_file() { local src="$1" dst="$2" required="${3:-true}" if aws s3 cp "$src" "$dst" --no-progress --only-show-errors; then return 0 fi if [[ "$required" == "true" ]]; then error "S3 copy failed (required): $src -> $dst" return 1 fi warn "S3 copy failed (optional): $src -> $dst" return 0 }
# ----------------------------- # Prereqs # ----------------------------- need aws need jq need java
S3_BUCKET="${S3_BUCKET:-avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl}" JOB_CONFIG_S3="${JOB_CONFIG_S3:-s3://${S3_BUCKET}/general/resources/job.config}" MAPPING_S3="${MAPPING_S3:-s3://${S3_BUCKET}/general/mappings/mapping.postrootnodes.csv}" OUT_S3_PREFIX="${OUT_S3_PREFIX:-s3://${S3_BUCKET}/general/completed/}"
ASSUME_DURATION_SECONDS="${ASSUME_DURATION_SECONDS:-3600}"
# ----------------------------- # Workspace dirs (cleanly) # ----------------------------- reset_dir data reset_dir completed reset_dir hierarchies reset_dir processing reset_dir mappings reset_dir resources reset_dir reports reset_dir logs rm -rf pic-sure-hpds/ || true
# ----------------------------- # Assume role once (keep creds for all S3 ops) # ----------------------------- assume_role
# ----------------------------- # Pull inputs needed by GenerateAllConcepts # ----------------------------- # IMPORTANT: # s3://bucket/prefix/ is not an object, so head-object on it will 404. # Use sync only for prefixes. s3_sync_prefix "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/general/data/" "data" false s3_sync_prefix "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/general/globalvars/study_consents/" "data" false
log "Downloading mapping.postrootnodes.csv -> mappings/mapping.csv" s3_cp_file "$MAPPING_S3" "mappings/mapping.csv" true
if [[ -s "data/studies_consents_mapping.csv" ]]; then log "Appending data/studies_consents_mapping.csv -> mappings/mapping.csv" cat "data/studies_consents_mapping.csv" >> "mappings/mapping.csv" else warn "data/studies_consents_mapping.csv missing/empty; not appending" fi
log "Downloading job.config -> resources/job.config" s3_cp_file "$JOB_CONFIG_S3" "resources/job.config" true
# ----------------------------- # Run generator # ----------------------------- log "Running GenerateAllConcepts.jar" java -jar jars/GenerateAllConcepts.jar -propertiesfile "resources/job.config" 2>>"logs/error_logging.txt"
if [[ -s logs/error_logging.txt ]]; then warn "GenerateAllConcepts wrote to logs/error_logging.txt (last 50 lines):" tail -n 50 logs/error_logging.txt >&2 || true # Uncomment to hard-fail on any logged errors: # error "Errors logged during GenerateAllConcepts"; exit 1 fi
# ----------------------------- # Upload outputs # ----------------------------- if [[ ! -s "completed/GLOBAL_allConcepts.csv" ]]; then error "Expected output not found or empty: completed/GLOBAL_allConcepts.csv" exit 1 fi
log "Uploading GLOBAL_allConcepts.csv -> ${OUT_S3_PREFIX}" aws s3 cp "completed/GLOBAL_allConcepts.csv" "${OUT_S3_PREFIX}" --no-progress --only-show-errors
log "Done"
